steps.en: OCMS validates the PLUS permanent suspension request and finds it not allowed
steps.id: OCMS memvalidasi permintaan permanent suspension dari PLUS dan menemukan tidak boleh
steps.why_en: Pre-check for already suspended notices skips the stage and court rule, so it can say allowed when the real run rejects.
steps.why_id: Pre-check untuk notice yang sudah suspended melewati aturan stage dan court, jadi bisa bilang boleh padahal proses sebenarnya menolak.

steps.en: OCMS sends PLUS an error message with the reason
steps.id: OCMS mengirim pesan error beserta alasannya ke PLUS

steps.en: The PLUS user sees that the suspension is not allowed
steps.id: User PLUS melihat bahwa suspension tidak diizinkan
steps.why_en: The message is sent, but how the PLUS screen shows it is outside the code we can see.
steps.why_id: Pesan dikirim, tetapi cara layar PLUS menampilkannya ada di luar code yang bisa kami lihat.
